title: Cyber-human social co-operating system: Application design and implementation
reasoning: The paper describes a cyber-human social co-operating system (Social Co-OS) designed for social decision-making and co-operation. While it incorporates social values through the 'Social Value Orientation' (SVO) metric and addresses social dilemmas, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics in the context of AI systems or as its primary research objective.
